# Systemd accounting and user resource classes. These do not change explicit
# unit policy for zram, Podman, user-1000.slice, or other existing workloads.
# Independent switches: accounting controls both manager defaults only;
# weight enablement controls all managed resource-policy IOWeight lines only.
# Neither disables controller delegation nor erases original workload policy.
SYSTEMD_DEFAULT_IOACCOUNTING_ENABLE="false"
SYSTEMD_IOWEIGHT_ENABLE="false"
SYSTEMD_IOWEIGHT_HOME_USER_SESSION_SLICE_D="IOWeight=200"
SYSTEMD_IOWEIGHT_HOME_USER_APP_SLICE_D="IOWeight=100"
SYSTEMD_IOWEIGHT_HOME_USER_BACKGROUND_SLICE_D="IOWeight=30"

# Per-service exception: compositor responsiveness within session.slice.

SYSTEMD_IOWEIGHT_HOME_USER_LABWC_COMPOSITOR_SERVICE_D="IOWeight=300"

# Aggregate system classes beneath system.slice (not new root-level budgets).

SYSTEMD_CPUWEIGHT_SYSTEM_BACKGROUND_SLICE_D="50"

# Seconds are integers; no per-source UID limit or tight fatal trigger limit.

# weight enablement controls all managed resource-policy IOWeight lines only.

# Set BOTH times (HH:MM, system local time) for a manual schedule; then only
